title: Movies without a director
statementMd:
List movies whose director is unknown.

Expected columns: `title`.

Tables: `movies`, `directors`, `reviews`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title FROM movies WHERE director_id IS NULL;
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
